fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2026-09-01, around 09:40, the owner of Kalai Home Appliances reported that cash of around Rs. 1,00,000 was taken under threat at Anbu Park Main Street in Trichy, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-09-03. Anitha Raj submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000399. The complainant is associated with the business Kalai Home Appliances. The complainant alleged that Chandran Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000064. A witness, Rajesh Krishnan, reachable on 9000000167, was mentioned in the complaint. Revathi Raman (9000000145), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly entered near closing time and threatened the staff.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, associate, mobile number, morning, suspect, witness, CCTV
